status: APPROVED FOR RESEARCH SIMULATION ONLY by owner 2026-11-09; not operational
purpose: Research-only simulator limits. Not Desk Rules v0.2 and not the Stage 2 Gate 1 policy. These numbers are not the operational GBP 2.50 per-trade risk cap or the GBP 5.00 daily-loss cap. Those operational figures are risk and loss caps, not position-size limits. They do not authorise execution.

account.note: Illustration assumption only. Not the operational simulated desk account of GBP 500.00.

notes: One-way turnover is 0.5 * sum of absolute instrument-weight changes. Cash is the residual and is not double-counted. Moving from literal cash to 100% in one risky instrument is 0.50 and is allowed. Swapping one fully invested risky instrument for another is 1.00 and is scaled.

PROPOSED XSTR exception: asset class cash_proxy may exceed the 50% single-instrument cap, up to its class cap of 100%. XSTR remains an investment with dealing costs, spreads, distributions, and swap counterparty risk. It is not literal cash and it is not a guaranteed rate.

PROPOSED risk-off exception: if every non-cash-proxy weight is unchanged or lower, the turnover cap does not scale the rebalance. A full exit from equity, bonds, or gold into XSTR or literal cash can complete in one rebalance. Any increase in a non-cash-proxy weight keeps the 50% cap on the whole rebalance.
The 0.20 commodity cap applies to SGLN. It is a placeholder, not an approved allocation.
